messages.subject: Maaden 2040 | Corporate affairs, local content and responsible growth leadership
messages.body:
Dear Corporate Strategy & Affairs Team,

Please place this confidential executive note before Mr. Mohammed Marwahi, Chief Strategy & Corporate Affairs Officer.

Maaden's 2040 agenda is more than a production-growth program. Scaling the Kingdom's mining sector into a third pillar of the economy requires corporate affairs, government alignment, local-content execution and community confidence to grow at the same pace as the asset base. Your combined Strategy and Corporate Affairs remit sits at the center of that challenge.

The part of Maaden's strategy I find most relevant is the need to connect growth with the institutions and communities surrounding it. The Tharwah local-content program, major exploration expansion, host-community investment and the ambition to build a globally significant minerals platform create a need for disciplined stakeholder architecture around projects, government commitments, supplier development and social-performance outcomes.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My operating-side work combines senior government and regulator engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, local participation, executive advisory and cross-functional action management across a large gold-mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around a mine-scale solar and battery platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot built from physical operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of mining, government relations, social performance and accountable execution might support Maaden's next phase, whether within Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships, responsible growth programs or a country-facing leadership mandate. I have prepared a concise Maaden-specific executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
